root_cause: The offcanvas component only activates its focus trap when the scroll configuration is false. With data-bs-scroll="true" (as used in the page), the focus trap is not activated, allowing focus to leave the panel on successive Tab presses.
repair_strategy: Modify the offcanvas show method to unconditionally activate the focus trap in the shown callback, preserving the existing scrollbar behavior.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab navigation will remain trapped within the offcanvas panel; repeated Tab presses will keep focus on the close button.
functional_risks: None identified; the change aligns with modal-like behavior expected for an offcanvas with role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
verification_requirements: After opening the help panel, the first Tab press must focus the close button.
A second Tab press must keep focus on the close button (not move to the amount field).
The panel should still be dismissible via the close button or Escape key.
When data-bs-scroll="false", scrollbar hiding behavior should remain unchanged.
